title: Storage and Warehousing
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure: Routine Warehouse Management Tasks) and Section 5 (Contingencies) of SOP-04, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 120-132 = PDF pages 126-138). This SOP is a set of routine monitoring tasks, not a sequence: the tasks carry no stated order between them, so they are modelled as independent roots, each with the contingency step it triggers as a conditional successor. Step text is the Key Step column verbatim, with long bulleted detail lists summarised to their lead line. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Monitoring of Warehouse Exterior - Ensure that ceiling, walls, floors and vehicle access are intact and in good condition

Perform Contingency Step 5.1: take photos showing the broken/non-functioning ceilings, drainage, lighting, and vehicle access; request for necessary repair and intervention; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to the Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are potential problems with the warehouse exterior

steps.text: Monitoring of Warehouse Interior - Ensure that ceiling, walls, floors and lighting are intact and in good condition

Perform Contingency Step 5.2: take photos showing the broken/non-functioning ceilings, drainage, and lighting; request for necessary repair and intervention; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to the Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are potential problems with the warehouse interior

steps.text: Monitoring of Space - Ensure that there is a designated area and ample space for the following: Receiving, Quarantine, Storage, Staging, Releasing, Rejected/Damaged/Pharmaceutical Wastes

Perform Contingency Step 5.3: take photos showing the current situation of the warehouse and produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to the Supply Officer; in cases of warehouse congestion, recommend facilitating stock transfer to other available warehouses if necessary
steps.condition: there is space congestion in various areas in the warehouse

steps.text: Segregation of Commodities - Ensure that items are efficiently segregated based on its proper area, considering that First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) and First-In-First-Out (FIFO) Principles are respected at all times
Stacking of Commodities - Ensure that products are consistently stacked as performed and stated during Put-Away process
Perform Contingency Step 5.4: instruct store keeper and store helper to correct the stacking based on the guidelines on proper palletization and adjust accordingly
steps.condition: there are commodities not properly stacked on pallet

steps.text: Product Quality Monitoring - Observe product quality by visually and randomly inspecting for broken/ripped packages, missing or incomplete quantity of items, unreadable/ripped Inventory Label Form, and product-specific defects

Perform Contingency Step 5.5 and refer to the process on Waste Management for Pharmaceuticals and Equipment (DOH-SCMS-WOM-SOP-07): take photos of the damaged and/or expired item/s and facilitate investigation on its occurrence; produce Incident Report (Annex 16) and inform the Store Manager
steps.condition: there are damaged and/or expired items discovered

steps.text: Ventilation - Ensure ventilation and cooling by opening windows or air vents of the storage areas to allow air circulation and promote dehumidification if relative humidity exceeds acceptable limits inside the warehouse/storeroom

Perform Contingency Step 5.6: take photos showing the broken/non-functioning unit of fan(s)/air vent(s) and request an additional unit if already insufficient; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14)
steps.condition: there are broken/non-functioning or insufficient fans/air vents

steps.text: Temperature and relative humidity monitoring - Ensure that thermohygrometer units are placed throughout the storage area for balanced monitoring

Manually update and record Temperature and Relative Humidity Readings at least twice daily (Morning and Afternoon) using monitoring chart until the computerized temperature monitoring system is functional
steps.condition: the computerized system fails to function

steps.text: Perform Contingency Step 5.7: take photos showing the broken/non-functioning Temperature and Humidity Monitoring Device and request additional unit if already insufficient; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14)
steps.condition: there are broken/non-functioning or insufficient Thermohygrometers

steps.text: Temperature Requirement - Store products based on its Temperature Requirement: Normal Storage Conditions (dry, well-ventilated premises at temperature 15 up to 30 Degree Celsius) or Defined Storage Conditions

Perform Contingency Step 5.8: ensure that air conditioners and fans are always working properly; if not, request for air-conditioning maintenance/repair and facilitate transfer of commodities to appropriate place/area in accordance with its storage temperature requirement immediately; initiate stock transfer to other warehouses if no suitable area exists
steps.condition: commodities stored are not in accordance to its storage temperature requirement

steps.text: Protection from Sunlight - Ensure that commodities are protected from direct sunlight
Product Identification - Ensure all products per pallet are properly identified with readable, accurate and complete Bin Card or Product Identification Label at all times
Perform Contingency Step 5.9: instruct Store keeper to produce/update Bin Cards and/or product labeling per pallet
steps.condition: there are unreadable labels and/or changes on the information per pallet

steps.text: FDA Status Identification - Ensure all products requiring FDA Test Analysis are properly affixed with readable, updated and complete FDA Status Label per pallet: Quarantine (yellow), Passed/Good Stocks (green), Failed/Bad Stocks (red)
Perform Contingency Step 5.10: instruct warehouse staff to affix an updated labeling on FDA Status per pallet
steps.condition: the FDA Status label is not updated

steps.text: Perform Contingency Step 5.11: instruct warehouse staff to affix Failed FDA Test Status Identification Label and facilitate transfer of commodities to isolated areas (Rejected/Damaged Area) not later than 24 hours upon receipt of FDA Test Result; produce an official letter to the supplier with the instruction to pull out failed commodities not later than five (5) days upon receipt of the letter
steps.condition: stored commodities on quarantine failed the test analysis of FDA

steps.text: Perform Contingency Step 5.12: instruct warehouse staff to affix Passed FDA Test Status Identification Label and facilitate transfer of commodities to appropriate area (Storage area) from Quarantine area; follow up the approved Allocation List and/or shipment plan from the end-user and supply planning unit
steps.condition: stored commodities on quarantine passed the test analysis of FDA

steps.text: Counter Checking of Bin Cards: check completeness and accuracy of data in Bin Cards; review all attachment of Bin Cards per pallet/location; make sure that Bin cards are accessible and appropriately placed in their designated Bin Card Holder or right next to the pallet/location of the item

Perform Contingency Steps 5.13-5.14: instruct Warehouse staff to produce/update Bin Card per pallet/location of item and to correct invalid data entry, update accordingly and complete all the attachments needed to support every transaction in the Bin Card
steps.condition: Bin Cards are not updated and/or there are discrepancies discovered

steps.text: Counter Checking of Stock cards: check completeness and accuracy of data in Stock cards; review all attachment of Stock Cards of all items stored ensuring that data complement with Bin Cards and other attachments; make sure that Stock cards are accessible and appropriately filed in their designated folder

Perform Contingency Steps 5.15-5.16: instruct Warehouse staff to produce/update Stock Card per item and to correct invalid data entry, ensuring that data between Stock Card and Bin Card complement each other
steps.condition: Stock cards are not updated and/or there are discrepancies discovered

steps.text: Counter Checking of Location Map: check the consistency of data in Stock Cards and actual count of commodities based on the location map; ensure that warehouse staff regularly update the Location Map every after transaction; conduct Random or cycle physical inventory on a weekly and monthly basis

Perform Contingency Steps 5.17-5.18: investigate why there are discrepancies between quantities on inventory and stock cards and correct accordingly; if there are missing items, perform physical inspection of the warehouse to locate products, review all CCTVs if necessary, produce Incident Report (Annex 16) and inform the Supply Officer
steps.condition: records are not updated and there are discrepancies discovered

steps.text: Inventory Report: check the consistency of data in monthly inventory report by comparing it with Stock Cards and actual count of commodities; counter check the expiry dates of commodities; regularly assess the stock status by calculating Months of Stocks and Average Monthly Consumption; monitor stocks based on the latest inventory policies on minimum/maximum level per commodity
Immediately inform the end-user and supply planning unit for urgent allocation and distribution
steps.condition: there are near expiring commodities (i.e., less than 12 months shelf life) in the inventory

steps.text: Inbound and Outbound Summary Report: check completeness and accuracy of data in Inbound and Outbound Summary; ensure that warehouse staff regularly update Inbound and Outbound Record every after transaction
Perform Contingency Step 5.19: instruct Warehouse staff to correct invalid data entry in the outbound/inbound summary report and complete missing data (if there are any)
steps.condition: records are not updated and/or there are discrepancies discovered

steps.text: Warehouse Operations Routine Checklist: accomplish quality checklist report (Annex 15) to ensure safe, efficient and quality warehouse operations at all times

Signage and Label for Safety and Precautionary Measures - Maintain precautionary measures to protect personnel and stored commodities by ensuring that floor markings and warehouse signage are complete and in place

Perform Contingency Step 5.20: determine what are the needed warehouse signage, floor markings including their quantity; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to Supply Officer
steps.condition: warehouse signage and floor markings are insufficient

steps.text: Equipment Maintenance - Maintain necessary equipment used for the operation and preservation of all commodities stored inside the warehouse: check Jack lifts, Trolleys, Forklifts, Forklift safety cage and other needed equipment for any necessary maintenance; check Ladders if available and properly functioning

Perform Contingency Step 5.21: take photos showing the broken/non-functioning Jack lifts/Forklift/Trolleys and Ladders; request additional unit if already insufficient; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are broken/non-functioning or insufficient warehouse equipment

steps.text: Sanitation - Clean receiving, quarantine, storage, staging, releasing and rejected areas to avoid any form of contamination
Perform Contingency Step 5.22: inform Store Manager of the needed cleaning materials and fill up Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14)
steps.condition: cleaning materials are insufficient and/or not functioning

steps.text: Protection against Pest: ensure to comply with latest Pest Control Guidelines; contact details of office/agency responsible for Pest Control shall be easily accessible in case of urgent need and for regular scheduling
Perform Contingency Step 5.23: inform Store Manager and coordinate with appropriate office/agency for Pest Control scheduling
steps.condition: there are pests discovered

steps.text: Garbage Management - Store garbage in covered receptacles and dispose garbage often, in a manner that avoids attracting pests
Pharmaceutical Waste Management - refer to the process on Waste Management for Pharmaceuticals and Equipment (DOH-SCMS-WOM-SOP-07) and ensure compliance with the latest guidelines from the DOH
steps.condition: pharmaceutical wastes are discovered

steps.text: Distribution & Transport Management - Ensure that latest SOPs for Shipping and protocols on distribution types are in place

Security Monitoring - Observe store security and safety of items: identify and provide increased security for products which are at risk of theft and abuse; separate corrosives, flammable and cytotoxic materials in a secured and isolated area; limit entry and keys to controlled locations; maintain logbooks and sufficient CCTVs

Perform Contingency Step 5.18: perform physical inspection of the warehouse to locate products; if products are located, instruct warehouse staff to update the documents accordingly; if not, investigate, review all CCTVs if necessary and produce Incident Report (Annex 16) and inform Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are missing items

steps.text: Safety and Precautionary Measures - Maintain precautionary measures to protect personnel and ensure that protective personal equipment are complete and in place

Perform Contingency Step 5.24: determine what are the needed personal protective equipment including quantity; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to Supply Officer
steps.condition: protective personal equipment is insufficient

steps.text: Protection against fire: make standard fire extinguishers or fire sprinklers available in every storage facility according to national regulations; visually inspect fire extinguishers/fire sprinklers every 2-3 months; service fire extinguishers and sprinklers at least every 12 months; ensure availability of smoke detectors and check them every 2-3 months; strictly prohibit smoking in the store; clearly mark emergency exits

Perform Contingency Step 5.25: determine what are the needed fire-fighting units and smoke detectors including their quantity; produce Corrective Requisition on Warehouse Operations (Annex 14) to be submitted to Supply Officer
steps.condition: there are broken/non-functioning or insufficient fire-fighting units and smoke detectors
